hypothesis: A development-trained native 5-parameter Torch merge gate over public adjacency-pair exposures/time and competition can outperform the unchanged deterministic first-adjacent merge policy under new graph-fork distractor structures, even when exposure evidence reverses.
mechanism: Learn only WHEN to merge an already-verified adjacent span-one pair. Four hand-coded public features, Torch nn.Linear(4,1) + bias, trained on development seeds30720..30767 using supervision for whether both adjacent edges belong to true target chains, validated 30816..30831 selecting threshold among {.35,.45,.5,.55,.65,.75}. The physical span2 representation, adjacency detection, original Torch learned graph-retention weights, memory eviction, native 6-parameter learned join and span-aware search remain frozen and hand-coded. Future targets never supplied to memory at test.
novel_heldout: 24 seeds 31616..31639 ×4 graph families: development-like fork distractors, reversed public exposure relevance, uniform exposure, alternating high-exposure decoys. All have two disjoint length4 true chains and four branch/incoming decoys, twelve admitted facts and two future queries per case.
competitors: Frozen NCI09 coded first-adjacent path compressor, frozen NCI07 7-edge graph-local learned retention and original full-12-edge exact oracle. Same 576 native StatePool bytes, seven active slots and Torch backend per compressed arms. Different memory encodings vs uncompressed comparator and differing per-step compute; track all operations. Learned vs coded compressed arms use the same state representation and query method.
acceptance: LEARNED_MERGE_GATE_TRANSFER only if exact oracle 192/192, new learned >=70% paired accuracy, gain >=10 points over coded NCI09 and every novel shifted family no worse than coded by >10 points; PARTIAL_LEARNED_MERGE_GAIN if +5 points overall; otherwise NO_LEARNED_MERGE_TRANSFER; invalid oracle overrides. Preserve original row-level record and every negative.
limits: Train a selection gate not compression representation, learned symbolic graph search, general language semantics, RSI or full NCI01. Same StatePool bytes but programmed structures and runtime work vary.
